install.windows_download: Open https://openai.com/codex/ in the browser, click the Windows download. Saves to %USERPROFILE%\Downloads by default.
install.macos_download: Open https://openai.com/codex/ in the browser, click the macOS download (.dmg). Saves to ~/Downloads by default.
install.linux: Linux preview: download the x64 / ARM64 .deb or .rpm linked at https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/linux/linux-app. Supported desktops: Ubuntu 24.04/26.04 LTS, Debian 13, Fedora 43/44. From Downloads install the selected .deb with apt or .rpm with dnf; launch `chatgpt`. The package registers the signed OpenAI update repository.
install.note: GUI desktop application. Windows uses the Microsoft Store package; macOS uses the official Apple Silicon build. Linux preview uses the official .deb / .rpm for the supported distribution and architecture. Report installer location for manual downloads and verify the app opens.

install_flow.summary: Detect OS and architecture → install the Store / macOS / Linux package → verify the app opens.
agent_steps: Detect OS and architecture first. macOS requires the Apple Silicon build; Linux preview supports the distributions and architectures listed in the Linux docs.
Windows: prefer `winget install --id 9PLM9XGG6VKS --source msstore` if available. Verify the package install result; no manual installer wizard is required for this path.
macOS: download the official app linked from https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/app to ~/Downloads, report its path, and open it for the user to install.
Linux: use https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/linux/linux-app to select the matching .deb / .rpm. Install with apt / dnf from the download directory. Let the user run sudo if elevation is unavailable.
Verify ChatGPT is present in the application menu and opens; the Linux launcher is `chatgpt`. Sign-in takes place inside the app.
tell_user: That they should click through the wizard themselves

identity_guard.description: ChatGPT is OpenAI's GUI app for the Codex coding agent (formerly named 'Codex Desktop'). It is DIFFERENT from the Codex CLI (`@openai/codex`). Both can coexist — the desktop app shares config under `~/.codex` with the CLI.
